description: 18/03/2026 The CMD of SIDBI delivered the opening keynote at Capital Connect 2026, organised by TiE Delhi-NCR, on the theme “India’s Growth Decade: The New Architecture of Capital, Innovation & Opportunity.” The address set the tone for the event by presenting a forward-looking perspective on India’s evolving economic landscape and the pivotal role of capital and innovation in shaping the country’s next phase of growth.
